result.question: How did Uzziah trespass against Yahweh?

readings.answer: By entering the temple of the LORD to burn incense on the altar of incense.
readings.support: he entered the temple of the LORD to burn incense on the altar of incense.

readings.answer: By burning incense on the altar of incense.
readings.support: to burn incense on the altar of incense.

readings.answer: By entering the temple of the LORD.
readings.support: he entered the temple of the LORD

readings.answer: By being unfaithful to the LORD his God.
readings.support: He was unfaithful to the LORD his God

assessments.reason: Matches the passage’s stated act: he entered the temple to burn incense on the altar, which is the trespass described.
Accurately captures the specific trespass named in the text—burning incense on the altar of incense in the temple.
It omits the key element—burning incense; the text specifies the wrongdoing as entering in order to burn incense, not mere entry.
This restates the general charge without answering how he trespassed; the passage specifies the act of burning incense as the manner.

result.reason: Readings 1 and 2 clearly match the key that Uzziah trespassed by burning incense in Yahweh’s house.
